results.content: With Ace, both educators and students get a trustworthy AI tool that helps them get the most out of the learning experience. Ace's AI-powered lecture enhancer makes it faster and easier to add low stakes assessments to in-class sessions, creating evidence-based learning experiences for your students. Ace offers AI-powered study support in the moment, when and where students need it. Ace’s new practice tool lets students test themselves with AI-generated questions built from the context of their course. * Students can practice independently by generating quick sessions of multiple choice questions based on page content. With Ace, educators can generate AI-powered questions that make it easier and faster to integrate low-stakes assessments into content for any course. * With one click, Ace generates questions, hints, and explanations, giving students more opportunities for practice and immediate feedback. Because Ace operates alongside course materials and has contextual knowledge of what is being studied, it can address student questions with relevant responses that are based on the specific course contents.
